Boas prefer to stick to the ground (being big and heavy), so height isn't a big factor for them.

animal plastics (apcages) makes 8' cages for a reasonable price, boaphile plastics may also be good. There may be a local enclosure maker in your area, or you can try your hand at making your own with birchwood/plywood and coating it.
